gallery.heading: Barcelona, a way of life
gallery.lead: Modernist architecture, Mediterranean light and distinctive period buildings that define the character of the city.
gallery.item1Subtitle: High ceilings with original mouldings and restored hydraulic floors.
gallery.item2Subtitle: Detached houses with large gardens and natural light all day long.
gallery.item3Subtitle: Reclaimed timber beams and original Gothic stone arches.
gallery.item4Subtitle: Modern spaces, refurbished with respect for the historic architecture.

philosophy.heading: Our *philosophy*
philosophy.text: A single advisor coordinates the paperwork, the viewings, the negotiation and every professional involved. And when something unexpected comes up, our answer is always the same:
philosophy.quote: «Don't worry, I'll take care of it».
